name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Slow-Roasted Tri-Tip Platter or Turkey Club on Sourdough
brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
searchKeywords: knotts sit down restaurant inside park
whyItWorks: Knott's best full-service restaurant inside the park gates (and accepts the Dining Plan!): offers a classic Roasted Turkey Club on toasted sourdough, grilled chicken breast, or Tri-Tip with mashed/baked potatoes in air-conditioned comfort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Club on Sourdough (no tomato or lettuce) with fries or mashed potatoes, or the Tri-Tip/Grilled Chicken entrée with sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the raw coleslaw and ask for boysenberry BBQ glaze on the side
